properties.content: Question: chipotle keto bowl nutrition facts Answer: A Chipotle Keto Bowl typically features a base of lettuce or supergreens, followed by your choice of protein (chicken, steak, or carnitas), and topped with fresh salsa (like pico de gallo or tomatillo-red chili), guacamole, and cheese. It is designed to be a low-carb, high-protein, and high-fat option. Here's a more detailed look at the nutrition: General Nutrition (per serving):: - Calories: Ranges from 470 to 740 depending on ingredients. - Macronutrients: Generally low in carbs, high in fat and protein. - Ingredients to watch out for (for keto): Avoid rice, beans, and corn salsa. - Key components to include: Leafy greens, protein, salsa, guacamole, cheese. Specific examples:: - Keto Salad Bowl (from a keto blog): 570 calories, 42g fat, 16g saturated fat, 14g carbs (7g net), 3g sugar, 31g protein. - Keto Salad Bowl (from MyNetDiary): 470 calories. - Chipotle Keto Bowl (from SnapCalorie): 337.3 calories, 18.9g protein, 24.9g fat, 9.5g carbohydrates (per cup, ~236.7 grams), according to SnapCalorie. - Keto Chipotle Bowl (from Eat This Much): 405 calories, 10% carbs, 52% fat, 37% protein, according to Eat This Much. - Chipotle Keto Bowl 1 (from Eat This Much): 740 calories, 11% carbs, 52% fat, 37% protein, according to Eat This Much. Tips for ordering:: - Choose a base of lettuce or supergreens. - Select your preferred protein (steak, chicken, carnitas, or sofritas). - Add salsa (pico de gallo, tomatillo-red chili). - Include guacamole and cheese. - Avoid rice, beans, and corn salsa. - Consider adding a side of sour cream or guacamole.

It is designed to be a low-carb, high-protein, and high-fat option.
Here's a more detailed look at the nutrition:
General Nutrition (per serving)::
- Calories: Ranges from 470 to 740 depending on ingredients.
- Macronutrients: Generally low in carbs, high in fat and protein.
- Ingredients to watch out for (for keto): Avoid rice, beans, and corn salsa.
- Key components to include: Leafy greens, protein, salsa, guacamole, cheese.
Specific examples::
- Keto Salad Bowl (from a keto blog): 570 calories, 42g fat, 16g saturated fat, 14g carbs (7g net), 3g sugar, 31g protein.
- Keto Salad Bowl (from MyNetDiary): 470 calories.

- Choose a base of lettuce or supergreens.

- Add salsa (pico de gallo, tomatillo-red chili).
- Include guacamole and cheese.
